anomalies.observed: U4 (the TPS62933 buck converter that generates the +5V rail) has its EN pin (pin 2) flagged as no-connect and not attached to any net. Its VIN, SW, FB, SS, RT and BST pins are all connected.
anomalies.expected: The enable pin of the buck regulator should be defined: tied to VIN or a pull-up for always-on operation, or driven by the MCU. Leaving it floating makes the 5 V rail's start-up state indeterminate.
anomalies.impact: The +5V rail that powers the ESP32 DevKit and the AZ1117 LDO may fail to start reliably or may be disabled by an undefined EN level, which would leave the controller unpowered.

anomalies.observed: The microstep-select pins are inconsistent across the three TMC2209 drivers. U9 has MS1 and MS2 both unconnected. U1 has MS1 unconnected and MS2 on +3V3. U11 has MS1 and MS2 both tied to +3V3.
anomalies.expected: The three identical pump drivers should share one microstep configuration, with MS1/MS2 set explicitly and consistently for the same motor behaviour.
anomalies.impact: The pH-Down pump driver may run at a different microstep resolution from the two nutrient drivers, changing dosing behaviour. The effect is likely small because the UART bus can override microstepping.
